security_implications: The chunk gates the RV_DM hardware debug enable, a primary access‑control signal. The OR condition that includes otp_dis_rv_dm_late_debug (OTP late debug disable) may be logically inverted: a true OTP disable would select the raw debug enable instead of forcing a disabled value, potentially granting debug access in contradiction to OTP configuration. This would undermine secure boot and debug locking. Additionally, invalid mubi inputs could cause unintended DFT or debug enable paths.
